verdict: Not ready to trust. The 6 test files pass (116 pass, 0 fail, 5 needs-app skips), and 26 of 30 mutations of the core mechanisms were caught. Two of the 4 survivors were redundant guards; the other two left tms mechanisms untested. Probes against the real scripts confirmed 4 defects, 2 of them high: (1) promote revert reads only a card's last status line, so an unqualified class's confirmations survive and an unrelated class reverts real ones; (2) commit's R34 URL check always passes, because the URL is in the Write tool use that created the card. Medium findings: commit accepts a pack whose parent is a rejected same-run pack, then fsck exits 3; commit writes view/*.json through a junction; number-uncited ignores sign; promote's outside_conditions card verdict is invisible to tms; fsck reads the status writers without the lock (a spurious tamper exit 3 is possible), and tms computes without the lock; tms tests miss questions-changed, the conditions cover, and the strict sesoi bar. findings.claim: revert --class looks only at each card's LAST status line, but promote itself writes status-keeping lines after a confirmation: card-item unclear/outside_conditions lines, sentence-unqualified lines, and sentence-check lines with a non-confirmed verdict, none with classes; and sentence-check confirmed lines with classes J1-J4 carry the card's current status. So revert J2 leaves a J1/J2/J4 confirmation standing when a later status-keeping line is the last one; revert J3 knocks down a card confirmation that relied only on J1/J2/J4; and revert J3 writes no line for a witnessed card whose sentence check (classes J1-J4) cleared an R18 flag, so lib.flagCleared still counts the clearing. CONTRACT 3.15 says a revert line is written for every confirmation whose classes include Jk.
findings.evidence: Probe review-tmp/U2/tcb/test/promote-probe.test.mjs against the real script: A confirmed {J1,J2,J4}, then an unclear card-verdict line (status kept, no classes); revert --class J2 adds 0 lines and A stays confirmed. Second probe: A confirmed {J1,J2,J4} then sentence-check {J1-J4}; B witnessed then sentence-check {J1-J4}. revert J3 writes A:witnessed:unqualified-revert and nothing for B. Spec T12 builds only last-line confirmations.
findings.fix: In planRevert, per card: the card's reliance = classes of its latest checker-confirmed line (if the card is still confirmed); a sentence clearing = any sentence-check confirmed line whose classes include Jk with no later unqualified-revert naming Jk. Write one unqualified-revert line {classes:[Jk]} when either holds. Status: witnessed if the reliance includes Jk, else the current status. Add T12 cases.

findings.claim: The R34 URL check searches the inputs of EVERY tool use, Write/Edit/Bash included, by substring. A session that writes a card with Write puts the URL into that input, so every session-written card passes, fabricated URLs included. A second route: harvest takes the session's own StructuredOutput inputs as candidates, and commit never URL-checks origin 'harvested'.
findings.evidence: Probe review-tmp/U2/tcb/test/commit-probe.test.mjs: the transcripts fetch only A_URL; card b (B_URL) is staged, and the helper transcript holds only a Write of staging/cards/b.card.json with b's JSON. intake stores b (B_stored=true). Spec T6 transcripts have no Write tool use.
findings.fix: Build the URL corpus only from toolAccess kinds fetch/search/read (access.urls) and from those calls' results and helpers' structured results. Never use write or exec inputs, nor the session's own StructuredOutput. In harvest, take the session's own StructuredOutput only from helper transcripts, or mark such cards so commit URL-checks them. Add a test with the URL present only in a Write input.

findings.claim: A pack/review parent is accepted when it names any same-run candidate (packCandIds/reviewCandIds), including a rejected one. The child is stored with a dangling parent, and the next fsck exits 3 fk-missing (tamper, all work stops). The spec says the parent must be stored.
findings.evidence: Probe review-tmp/U2/tcb/test/commit-probe.test.mjs: P1 (wrong questions_sha) and P2 {parent: P1}; intake rejects P1 and stores P2; fsck then exits 3 with fk p_..->p_.. fk-missing.
findings.fix: Check parent against the accepted sets (packById / okReviews ids, fixpoint as for supersedes), or follow the spec: stored only.

findings.claim: intake writes view/rejected.json and view/committed.json with writeAtomic and never checks that view/ is not a link. The untrusted attempt folder can make view/ a junction, and commit then writes, replacing any existing file of those names, wherever it points, including outside the run root.
findings.evidence: Probe review-tmp/U2/tcb/test/commit-probe2.test.mjs: view/ made a junction to <root>/outside-target. intake exits 0 and the target gets committed.json and rejected.json.
findings.fix: lstat the attempt dir and view/. A link, a non-directory or !isUnder(viewDir, attemptDir) means exit 3 untrusted-path with the incident, as for staging. Add a test.

findings.claim: number-uncited compares magnitudes only: Math.abs(Math.abs(r)-Math.abs(n)). A sign in the text is parsed and then discarded, so '+12.5%' against a card value of -12.47 raises no flag. By hand: r=roundTo(-12.47,1)=-12.5 and n=12.5, so ||r|-|n||=0, a hit.
findings.evidence: Code reading and the hand computation above. No test has a sign mismatch.
findings.fix: When the text number has an explicit sign (m[1] non-empty), compare signed (|r-n|<=eps). Add a test.

findings.claim: For a card-item verdict outside_conditions, promote writes reason 'unclear' but keeps check.verdict 'outside_conditions'. tms marks support-unclear only when check.verdict === 'unclear', so the sentences citing that card stay IN instead of JUDGMENT.
findings.evidence: promote.mjs 204-213 builds check {verdict} and pushes reason 'unclear'; tms.mjs 290 tests ls.check.verdict === 'unclear' only.
findings.fix: In tms treat ls.reason === 'unclear' || ls.check?.verdict === 'unclear' as support-unclear, or have promote record check.verdict 'unclear'. Add a test.

findings.claim: Phase 1 reads the ledger, then card_status.jsonl and witness.jsonl, without the lock. Phase 2 never re-reads them or reruns check 5. If promote or witness appends its status lines between the two reads, fsck reports status-unlogged, exits 3 (tamper) and appends a fail line that blocks commit records until a rerun.
findings.evidence: Code reading: led1 is read at 558, the status files at 561-562, and checkStatus at 564 is never recomputed in finish(). promote appends status lines and then its ledger line under the lock (promote.mjs 409-415).
findings.fix: In finish(), under the lock, re-read both status files and rerun checkStatus and checkFk against led2.

findings.claim: compute() reads everything without the lock, and the result is written under it without re-checking those inputs. A slower run can overwrite newer labels.json/repair.json with labels from older inputs and log a tms check line with that stale labels_sha. render's status_seq guard catches only status changes.
findings.evidence: Code reading: compute at 536, withRunLock at 550, nothing re-read inside the lock.
findings.fix: Run compute() inside the lock callback (no subprocess there), or compare the status last seq, ledger head and object/commit listings under the lock and recompute if any moved.

findings.claim: The questions-changed STALE rule (CONTRACT 3.18) has no test: removing it leaves the tms tests green.
findings.fix: Add a test with a protocol-amend that changes question_ids: the conclusions and the review sentences are STALE questions-changed, exit 1.
